scenes.context: 手是悬挂重物，要呈现向下的重量感。
sentences: 手是一个悬挂重物，它是挂在这儿的，所以它还存在一个重量。
The hand is a hanging weight, suspended, so it carries weight.
hanging weight（悬挂重物）
重力方向是向下的，如果你做了一件反重力的事情，符合常规认知吗？
Gravity points down—anti-gravity doesn't match common sense.
anti-gravity（反重力）
当你的手没有出现一种向下的重量感的时候，别人就会觉得你没放松。
Without a downward weightiness, people read you as tense.
weightiness（重量感）
scenes.speak: The hand is a hanging weight, suspended, so it carries weight. Gravity points down—anti-gravity doesn't match common sense. Without a downward weightiness, people read you as tense.

sentences: 手臂向上的时候要有支撑力，但是处于平行线以下的下行状态的时候，手腕处要保持完全放松。
Upward arms need support; below the line, the wrist stays fully relaxed.
support up, relax down（上撑下松）
如果你想要松弛感，你一定是这样处理的。
If you want that relaxed feel, this is how you handle it.
relaxed feel（松弛感）

scenes.speak: Upward arms need support; below the line, the wrist stays fully relaxed. If you want that relaxed feel, this is how you handle it. Hold the bag in hand, let it hang—it looks better.

practice: The hand must have support—you control it.
The hand is a hanging weight under gravity.
An anti-gravity hand reads as tense.
Below the line, the wrist stays fully relaxed.
pitfalls: Force a supportive pose that looks stiff.
Support alone isn't good—check the pose.
Let it hang with a downward weightiness.
Keep the wrist tensed below the line.
Fully relax the wrist in downward states.
下行状态手腕要完全放松。
Let it hang naturally by your side.
Ignore what hands read to viewers.
手的状态就是松弛的信号。
